text:
# Close wrap: Tue 2026-11-17 (~4:30 PM ET)

**Indexes:** Dow -1.6% (50,759), S&P -1.0% (7,340), Nasdaq -0.7% (24,328). It was a second straight down day. Tech-glitch nerves (CNN reported the NSA's internal network was down) and AI selling drove it ([Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/dow-dives-848-points-as-nsa-outage-wrecks-tech-stock-market-today), [SA](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4673887-wall-street-ends-in-the-red-as-tech-continues-its-struggle)). Retail sales rose +0.2% (in line), and ex-autos/gas came in at +0.6% vs +0.4% ([Yahoo/GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/dow-plunges-700-points-p-180432792.html)).

**Movers:** CRM -9.6%, the worst stock in the Dow and its biggest drop since May 2024, ahead of Thursday's Anthropic debut. HD -2.4% on its guide and the CEO exit ([Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/dow-dives-848-points-as-nsa-outage-wrecks-tech-stock-market-today)). Managed care fell on CMS's CRUSH proposal: UNH -5.4% ($389.81) and HUM -3.9% ($443.43) ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/unitedhealth-stocks-fall-4-62-183758976.html), [WSO](https://wallstreetobserver.com/articles/cms-fraud-rule-unitedhealth-humana)). ACM +11.4% ($80.78) and DIS -1.9% ($116.49) ([stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/acm/history/)).

**After hours:** NVDA closed -0.4% at $155.46 before the print ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/business/business-news/live-blog/nvidia-stock-earnings-report-jensen-huang-rcna609804)). Revenue was about $109B, in line with consensus and above its own $108B guide ([Woofun](https://www.woofun.ai/en/flash/detail/112535)). The January-quarter guide (Street ~$125-130B), gross margin (≥71%), and the 5 PM Kress call decide the reaction. Options priced a ~7-8.5% move ([24/7](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/17/nvidia-reports-in-about-an-hour-options-price-an-8-5-move-twice-what-the-stock-has-averaged-after-its-last-8-reports/)). I haven't verified the AH move.

**Tomorrow:** TGT, LOW, and TJX report BMO, housing starts at 8:30, FOMC minutes at 2 PM, and PANW AMC.

**Signals:** chip/AI-hardware avoids extended to 11/19. CRM added to avoid through 11/20. The managed-care group stays in avoid through 11/20. DIS was voided because it faded red.

**Swing ideas:**
- **ACM** (conditional met, logged at the $80.78 close): Q4 beat, record $28B backlog, 10% dividend hike, and the AH gain held and grew. Confidence: low. Risk: revenue miss, in-line FY27 guide, and the stock is extended after an 11% gap in a weak tape.
